name: Lazulight: By Your Side
source:
Experience school life with the members of Lazulight in this unofficial free fan-game. Go through a story full of ups and downs as you face new challenges and overcome your problems with the help of your new friends.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2808640]Steam[/url]]
